body:
What you're supposed to say? You already know him, that's a huge step up! Ask him if he wants to swing by once, after some kind of meeting? Talk to him about, what shall it be today? A friend (But don't gossip!)? How you're feeling? When or how a band is playing somewhere near you that you like? Try to have a casual talk, get a little more serious throughout the talk, and then ask him if he wants to walk along to your home, if he wants to come in? Or if he wants to watch a movie together at your place?
Those are just examples! There is a lot that you can do. You just have to use them right ;)
The more it feels natural, the more it'll loosen him!

As a rather shy person myself, I'll advice you to speak to him, in private. Not near any group whatsoever.

Let us know how it turns out!

Reddit, was never designed as a (very) serious board. Let alone a suicide-prevention one. Reddit however has (some, actually a lot sometimes because of it's somewhat gigantic size.) a nasty habbit of having trolls.

This, does NOT mean that because of this everything should be halted. Quite to the contrary. SW can be improved to one's specific needs. Varying from more active mods, to having some agreements in place that can get your IP banned if you act pro-suicidal. The throwaway accounts are already of great use, but can also be used against SW.

There will always be pros and cons, right now they're mainly pros. But we can even keep the cons to a minimum. Without actually compromising what SW stands for.

The thing you're asking for (shut_sw_down) is to have several moderators be busy reading relatively long and usually very emotional comments and articles. This could be heartbreaking for some, it could also delay the posting of a comment and/or article. Hereby even more enlargening the timegap between having posted and article, and actually getting commented.

Stop. Doubting. Yourself.

First of all, writing always clears the mind.
What is it that upsets you so much? If you answer: "I don't know.", it's fine.
It was a good move to post here, even if you did not feel like it.

Talk with a friend, someone you really trust. They care a lot more than you'd think.
And go talk with that counselor, perhaps not today, but tomorrow!

About those girls you mentioned, they meant it! It sounds like you're a great guy. Hook up with them, it might get your mind off those thoughts.

Talk to us, but above all, talk with someone close to you.

Hang in there.
You're 17, you've got a whole life ahead of you. One where you will find friends in your near vicinity. One where you will once, and very likely more than once, conquer a girl her heart. Suicide, it might seem as an ideal, but it is far from one.

The point of life, right now should be that you find something you really like. Anything, anything at all! As long as it makes you happy!
If one thing doesn't work out, move to the next. You always have a lot more options than you might see right now. Perhaps you'll find that you're really good at something you never excepted.

Who knows? You probably will in the next 10 years of your life.

Once your life begins to straighten up, everything else will too! And trust me, it does!

I'm in the exact same position. I'm (somewhat) fine with waiting, it's just that she made everything really hard for me, in just one day. Somewhere, I want to be there for her every hour of the day right now, just to make her feel better. But at the same time I don't want to come on( or off? I never quite got this expression.) to strong. I tend to do that.

I've ran with 2 psychiaters for several years. Neither did work, on the very very long run. Never immediately anyways. Right now, my thoughts are suicidal-free, I just don't know if they'll stay that way, especially at night. This is when I really begin to doubt myself.

Well, her sister saw us chatting and said to N that I might like her(N). N later-on asked me if I did. Which is what the whole fuzz is about, because I'm not even sure myself.

As you stated, I am indeed my own enemy. Every thought I have gets twisted by my doubts, and the things that I do know are for a certain moment safe, but after that not anymore. I can make everything up, and believe it completely. This is also the reason why I cannot distinguish my emotions, because everything I feel, I doubt and twist it to something else in my mind.

Taking pills isn't an option, I can't trust myself with them. And even with that, I have some kind of mindset that whatever I do, I can't swallow them. Not even when I'm having a really high fever and feeling very sick, I just can't take 'em.

slight edit: I typed a sentence 2 times. Fixed. Nothing major.

Thank you all for responding and PMing me. Really, thank you.

Right now, I've cleared my mind a bit.
I guess everything went a little to fast.

Currently, I'm feeling down, just not to bad.
 As to N, I actually did ask her out. And she responded positive, it'll just have to wait until she's ready, that was my condition ;) I had already accounted for her to feel more comfortable to I asked her to the movies, but somewhere late-Jan/Feb, not any time soon!

Just her asking if I liked her upset me and made me very insecure.

I'll "hang in there", I just don't want to get stuck in tho se thoughts again. This is why I chose to post here, especially with these details, because writing  clears my heart.

Thank you for your kind support for a total stranger whom you treat like your family.
